title: Prometheus logging lots of `superfluous response.WriteHeader call from go.opentelemetry.io/contrib/instrumentation...` errors
body:
### What did you do?

Build and run Prometheus from current `main` with any config (a completely empty file will do).

### What did you expect to see?

No errors being logged.

### What did you see instead? Under which circumstances?

The terminal is being flooded with lots of errors like:

```
ts=2024-09-07T19:25:28.219Z caller=stdlib.go:105 level=error component=web caller="http: superfluous response.WriteHeader call from go.opentelemetry.io/contrib/instrumentation/net/http/otelhttp/internal/request.(*RespWriterWrapper).writeHeader (resp_writer_wrapper.go:78" msg=)

```

From a `git bisect`, it seems like this issue was introduced in an automatic dependency upgrade in https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/pull/14834#issuecomment-2334789149

### System information

Linux 6.10.7-arch1-1 x86_64

### Prometheus version

```text

  build user:       someone@builder
  build date:       20240827-21:37:11
  go version:       go1.23.0
  platform:         linux/amd64
  tags:             unknown
```


### Prometheus configuration file

